top_issues: The 'Promised $140.00' green/violet legend block is a dense prose paragraph — the product's core idea is buried in text instead of a scannable rule.

The primary Pay button is indigo (#6D5DF6) while the 'promised' risk color is violet (#8B7CF6); the action color and the at-risk color are in the same hue family, so a user can read an action as risk.
'Show 2 empty' (BALANCES header) is terse copy; the H1 bar's small violet segment reads as a tiny balance without context.
fixes: Convert the legend into a two-tile key with a one-line rule ("Violet = you can lose it") behind a first-run tooltip instead of always-on prose.
Shift the action accent to a more saturated indigo/blue (#4F5BF5) and the 'promised' risk to a warmer magenta-violet (#A46CE8) so they never read the same.
Replace 'Show 2 empty' with 'Show 2 empty lanes →' and add a caption under the H1 bar: 'violet = promised, may fail'.

top_issues: The three green legend dots (On-chain/Reserve/Secured) are identical, so 'Secured $0.00' and 'Reserve $40.00' read as the same category even though Secured means collateral behind receivables.
The gray cents in '$180.00' are premium and legible but can read as 'disabled' on lower-contrast OLED panels.
The Pay/Receive/Swap button row uses indigo for Pay only, while the balance bars' violet is close — the hue collision persists on the strongest screen.
fixes: Give 'Secured' a teal-green (#27C08A) vs Reserve pure green (#22C55E) and add a small lock icon to Secured.
Bump the cents gray from #8B8B93 to #A8A8B0 for OLED legibility.
Nudge Pay/CTA indigo to #4F5BF5 and promised-violet to #A46CE8 (same rule as Home bottom).

top_issues: 'Fee 0.000050 USDC' is a bare decimal; 0.000050 reads as 'almost free' but is 50 nano-USD — no fiat equivalent, so a first-timer can't weigh it.
'2 ROUTES' shows two options but only the first is highlighted; the second (You→H1→H3→H2) has no fee/arrival delta, so the choice is a guess.
Route chips are small and the right-aligned 'You send 25.00' is the dimmest text on the card.
fixes: Add a fiat equivalent ('0.000050 USDC ≈ $0.00005') and a per-route delta ('+0.000025 via H3').
Annotate each route card with arrival time and hop count ('H3 — 2 hops').
Brighten 'You send 25.00' to full white and enlarge route chips to 40px.

top_issues: The recipient address (0x92c2…a1b0609…) wraps mid-hash onto a second line, breaking the 'copy whole address' model and risking a manual typo.
'Up to 200.00 instantly' is dim and small; the user can't tell if 25 is within the safe instant range without reading the bar in the next card.
The '1 OTHER ROUTE' disclosure is easy to miss — users may not realize a cheaper route exists.
fixes: Truncate the address to one line ('0x92c2…2cbf0') with a 'Full' expander and a Copy button.
Turn the top 'Up to 200.00 instantly' into a green pill linking to the capacity bar.
Replace '1 OTHER ROUTE' with 'See cheaper route · -0.000025 USDC'.

top_issues: 'Proof 0x835d…695a' is truncated with no copy/expand; a treasurer can't paste it into an external verifier from the receipt.
'Verified by your runtime' (green) reuses the success green with a different meaning (verification vs settled), a minor semantic overlap.
'Settled 03:57:12 · in 9s' — the valuable '9s' is buried next to the timestamp in small type.
fixes: Make Proof a tappable copy-to-clipboard row with an explicit 'Copy proof' affordance.
Render the runtime line in a neutral/blue tint and keep green strictly for settled/success.
Promote '9s' to its own pill ('Settled in 9s') next to the checkmark.

top_issues: The dimmed Home behind shows '$162.99' while the payment was 25.00 from $180.00; without a 'what changed' note the math looks wrong and erodes receipt trust.
The receipt sheet's X is the only exit; the half-visible Pay/Receive/Swap behind encourages accidental taps.
'Verified by your runtime' text sits on the dim background and competes with the dimmed Home numbers.
fixes: Add a 'what changed' line ('-25.00 payment, +7.99 from swap') or freeze the backdrop.
Make 'Done' the primary and the X secondary with a scrim tap-to-dismiss.
Elevate the sheet surface and deepen the backdrop (~0.7) so status text stays readable.

top_issues: 'Your entity id' is a 64-char hex wall (0x76bff0…c156) wrapping to three lines — impossible to verify or copy from memory, no short-id or copy affordance.
'Anyone with an account route to you can pay this id directly' assumes the reader knows what an 'account route' is.
'Prepare incoming account / H1-Testnet' is collapsed, hiding whether an inbound capacity check will block the payment.
fixes: Show '0x76bff0…c156' on one line with a Copy icon + 'Verify code' expander.
Reword to 'Anyone on the network can pay this ID directly — like a bank account number.'
Show the inbound capacity result inline ('H1 can accept 3.00 now') instead of behind the collapsed selector.

top_issues: The QR is pure cream on pure dark — the brightest object on screen; good for scanning but it dominates and pushes 'amount 0.00 optional' to dim secondary.
The QR has no scan-confirmation affordance ('Check if received'), so a payer can't tell when it lands.
'3.00 capacity via H1' is the only capacity signal and it's tiny top-right.
fixes: Frame/dim the QR slightly so the amount and controls hold hierarchy.
Add a 'Check if received' button that flips the QR to a status view after a scan.
Make the capacity a green pill ('H1 can accept 3.00') at the top of the amount card.

top_issues: Asks are orange-red while the legend elsewhere uses orange for 'you owe' — a trader can momentarily read ask depth as a risk indicator.
'Tap a level to fill the ticket at that price' is one long line with no example, and the 1-tick=1/10,000 note is buried.
The book shows sizes and bars but no cumulative depth or a bisecting midpoint emphasis.
fixes: Shift asks to a neutral red (#E5484D) and reserve orange strictly for 'you owe'.
Split the helper into two short lines with a sample ('Tap 2,500.5000 → fills 8.7453 WETH') and move tick size to the header.
Add a subtle mid-line and cumulative depth shading so the midpoint reads at a glance.

top_issues: The '100% collateral → 0% collateral' slider is the core new risk control but has no caption explaining the WETH trade-off or that the purple side is a hub promise.
'Swap USDC for WETH' appears disabled while the slider is at 0%; no error text explains why it can't submit.
'Bilateral · signed by both sides' is blue text that could be read as a link rather than a statement.
fixes: Add a caption: 'More collateral = less counterparty risk, slightly less WETH. 100% is safest.'
Add an inline reason above the CTA when it can't fill ('Needs 0.03 WETH more — set 50% collateral or extend the limit').
Render the settlement line as a static label with an info icon, not link-colored.

top_issues: 'Your credit line to them 143.00' vs earlier 'send up to 200.00' — two different caps appear in the same flow and the user can't tell which is real.
The 5-color legend (secured/promised/you owe/credit room/in flight) has no in-context example; 'credit room' and 'in flight' are never shown as bars.
'Show 2 empty lanes · WETH, USDT' is plain text, not a tappable lane selector.
fixes: Label the credit-line row 'Your cap to them (credit line)' and the capacity row 'Route capacity you can use now'.
Dim legend entries not used on this card ('credit room', 'in flight') until they appear.
Make 'Show 2 empty lanes' a button opening the lane desk, and fix the wrap so 'via' doesn't orphan.

top_issues: The 5-button action grid puts 'Dispute' — a security action — in a plain dark button equal in weight to 'Manage'.
The hub address is truncated well but has no copy/'view full'; needed if a hub misbehaves.
The top legend dashes are small text with tiny swatches, hard to read on mobile.
fixes: Give 'Dispute' a distinct outline/warning treatment and place it after a divider.
Add a copy icon + 'View full' next to the hub address.
Increase legend swatch size to 14px and label-row height.

top_issues: The 'Accou' filter chip is clipped at the right edge; the horizontal scroll isn't discoverable and no per-filter counts are shown.

Status chips use green for settled/filled and orange for 'open', but 'open' for 'Swap placed 20.00 USDC' uses orange where the wallet elsewhere uses violet for 'promised' — risk statuses are inconsistent.
'Export CSV' is plain text with no affordance, confirmation, or hint of what it exports.
fixes: Add a scroll chevron on the filter row and show counts per chip.
Use violet for 'open/promised' and orange only for 'you owe'/danger, matching the legend.
Turn 'Export CSV' into a button with a progress state and specify 'Export this view'.

top_issues: The failed payment shows only 'system/info' as the Detail — an opaque, non-user-facing reason with no retry and no human explanation.
More than half the screen is empty dark space above the sheet; on mobile it reads as a broken/blank state rather than a modal.
'From your runtime's committed frames' is green on a failed receipt, conflicting with the red 'FAILED' heading.
fixes: Replace 'system/info' with a human reason (e.g., 'Hub H2 did not confirm within 30s · funds returned to H1') plus Retry and Copy-proof actions.
Remove the void by reducing sheet height or highlighting the relevant activity row behind it.
Recolor the runtime line neutral/blue for failures; keep green for settled/filled.

top_issues: 'Reveal recovery phrase' is a high-stakes action shown as a normal button next to 'Lock' with no warning/delay — easy to fat-finger while scrolling.
'AT THIS SCALE' shows $100 = 10px as a sub-pixel sliver; a non-zero small balance can be effectively invisible at the default scale.
'Forget vault' is red and bundled with the unrelated reveal/lock actions in one row.
fixes: Add a confirmation dialog with hold-to-reveal on 'Reveal recovery phrase'.
Start the scale so the smallest non-zero balance is ≥4px and add an 'Expand smallest' toggle.
Separate 'Forget vault' into a red-outlined destructive row below the reveal/lock pair.

top_issues: The three Home toggles are all on with no note that disabling them changes what 'Green/violet' means; a user could turn off 'Accounts' and not understand why a balance label changes.
'Dollars per pixel' has a slider AND preset chips — two inputs fighting for the same state.
'Layout on wide screens / Desk' is described but 'Comfort'/'Desk' chips offer no preview.
fixes: Add per-toggle notes ('Accounts off → those balances become promised only').
Keep one input (slider OR chips) and use the other as a readout.
Add a thumbnail preview of Comfort vs Desk so it's not a blind toggle.

top_issues: 'WHAT HAPPENS' only explains 'Fund you through H1'; when the destination is Wallet/Reserve the preview doesn't update, so the explanation can contradict the choice.
The 'TO' destination row is cut at the bottom, so the user can't see where the funds go before committing.
'Add to batch' is a power feature buried small in a primary flow.
fixes: Make 'WHAT HAPPENS' react to the selected TO lane and show the destination summary above the CTA.
Move the destination summary ('TO: Account · instant') directly above 'Sign & send' so it's never off-screen.
Show an explicit batch count when used ('Add to batch · 2nd of 5').

top_issues: The FROM Wallet card shows '0.00 USDC' but is still selectable; a user can pick an empty lane and hit a confusing no-funds state.
'Recipient entity · leave empty for yourself / 0x… entity id' uses a fake hex that looks like a real address — ambiguous whether to type.
'Into an account with H1' and 'Recipient entity' are two destination inputs that can conflict.
fixes: Dim/disable empty-source cards so a user can't pick a 0.00 lane.
Change the placeholder to 'recipient id (optional — leave empty for yourself)' with no fake hex.
Merge the free-text recipient field into the H1 selector when an account is chosen.

top_issues: 'Yours whatever a hub does $40.00' uses informal language for a treasurer and is repeated in the legend; the promise/enforceable framing could be sharper.
'NEEDS ATTENTION / Nothing waiting on you' is a large empty green card; on a real risk day it must carry severity, so the empty state dominates.
'Promised by hubs $140.00' (purple) and 'You owe $0.00' (white) aren't visually linked as the two counterparty-risk rows.
fixes: Use 'Enforceable now' / 'Hub promise' as the pairing and move 'whatever a hub does' to a tooltip.
Make 'NEEDS ATTENTION' a live severity feed and shrink it when empty.
Put 'You owe' and 'Promised by hubs' on the same axis with the same accent.

top_issues: 'DEBTS' is a mostly-empty section with a one-paragraph definition; a user with no debts still reads it to confirm.
'FAUCETS / Test money from the network you are connected to' reveals a Testnet scenario inside a production-looking asset screen, which confuses a mainstream user.
Definition paragraphs are small and dense relative to the empty space.
fixes: Collapse 'DEBTS' to one line ('No debts on the Depository') with a 'what's this?' expander.
Move Faucets behind an explicit 'Dev tools' disclosure so Testnet never shows on the main asset view.
Bump paragraph size/leading in definition blocks.

top_issues: 'Depository may pull 0.00' under each asset never explains the pull right — a security-sensitive term that's glossed.
Gas '0.1000 ETH' is shown as a balance but there's no top-up action or low-gas warning.
Asset rows all show 0.00 with no visual difference between an empty lane and a checked lane.
fixes: Add a tooltip on 'may pull' ('Depository pulls only what you've escrowed') and highlight any non-zero pull.
Add a 'Get gas' affordance next to the gas balance and a low-gas warning threshold.
Fade empty (0.00) rows and add a '+ Add asset' affordance.

top_issues: 'Available 0.00 / Borrowed 0.00 / Active principal 0.00' are all zero with no explanation of the difference between Borrowed and Active principal.
The 'Offer to the pool' CTA is disabled but no reason is shown (amount is 0.00).
The pool header repeats 'Refresh' with no timestamp, so freshness is unknown.
fixes: Add a definition per row ('Borrowed: lent out now / Active principal: total lent + accrued interest').
Add a reason under the disabled CTA: 'Enter an amount to lend first.'
Add an 'as of 03:57:12' timestamp to the pool header.

top_issues: 'Interest you ask · basis points / 100' presents a raw bps number with '= 1.00% per term' as a small right-side note; the % should be primary for a lender.
Term cards (1 hour/1 day/1 month) are identical in weight so the active '1 day' is the only signal.
The disabled 'Offer to the pool (0.00)' gives no reason and no hint that the amount field drives it.
fixes: Make '1.00% per term' prominent with '100 bps' secondary, and add an APY estimate per term.
Add a check/fill on the active term card and a 'chosen' hint.
Add a reason above the CTA when 0.00: 'Enter an amount to lend.'

top_issues: 'Kind: Self-issued' and 'Threshold 1 of 1' are accurate, but a treasurer wanting multi-sig has no path from here to add signers/quorum.
The signer list only ever shows one ('you'), so there's no way to see or rotate board members from this screen.
'TAKE CONTROL OF ANOTHER ENTITY / Nothing to take over' is a large near-empty section.
fixes: Add a 'Set quorum'/'Add signer' action and show the board's signer list even at 1 of 1.
Add an explicit 'Rotate key' next to the signer.
Collapse 'Take control' to one line when empty ('No other entity lists your signer').

top_issues: 'Accounts co-signed 1 of 1' and 'Can dispute without asking 1 of 1' are strong but '1 of 1' is unexplained — the user can't tell if it's good or a single point of failure.
'Frame #44 · signed 1 min ago' is not openable; there's no way to verify the frame here.
'Save evidence bundle' is a large primary button but with no size/format hint or reminder that it must be stored off-device.
fixes: Add a caption: '1 of 1 = every account you hold is co-signed and callable; lower ratios mean fewer enforceable accounts.'
Make the frame row tappable ('Open frame #44') linking to a verifier.
Under Save evidence bundle add '~12 KB JSON · keep offline; it's the only proof that survives a hub failure.'

top_issues: The bar under '$40.00' shows two green segments then violet, but the legend lists three green items (On-chain/Reserve/Collateral) — a segment/legend mismatch.
'Green is yours whatever anyone does…' is a long paragraph under an already-informative legend; a skeptical investor must read it to confirm.
'Enforceable right now' is the strongest metric but there's no drill-down into what would change it.
fixes: Match the bar segments to the legend exactly (on-chain / reserve / collateral / promised) or fold them.
Trim the paragraph to two lines and keep the full version behind a 'what is enforceable?' expander.
Make '$40.00' tappable ('what makes this change?') leading to the Move/Reserve flow.

overall.verdict: A genuinely premium, consistency-tight wallet with the best trust-communication device in the category — the green/violet 'yours vs promised' split and the 'Enforceable right now' metric are excellent — but it's held back by an over-dense home legend, a few weak screens (the failed-receipt void and the receive entity-id wall), and a real risk that the action indigo and the 'promised' violet read as the same color. Fix the color collision, de-jargon the home, and give the expert users (Tomasz, Marcus, Kenji) in-context drill-downs and it becomes a standout, recommendable product.
priority_fixes: Separate the action indigo (#4F5BF5) from the 'promised/at-risk' violet (#A46CE8) and use orange strictly for 'you owe', so no button reads as risky and no risk reads as an action.
Turn the Home green/violet legend into a two-tile key with a one-line rule + first-run tooltip, and surface 'Enforceable right now $40.00' as the primary trust metric.
Fix the failed-payment detail (Activity) — replace 'system/info' with a human reason, add Retry/Copy-proof, and remove the empty void by framing it as a proper modal.
Give the Receive/entity-id screens a copyable short-id, a 'Check if received' status step, and an inline inbound-capacity result so payers and first-timers are never stranded on a hex wall.

Fix terse/cut microcopy and window layout: full 'Show 2 empty lanes' label, un-clip the 'Accounts' filter chip, move the destination summary above Sign & send, and add expert drill-downs (credit line vs capacity, Collateral slider caption, Desk lane preview).

personas.name: Maya
personas.verdict: I could get money in and pay my friend, but I read a whole paragraph before I trusted the $180.
blockers: Home: the Green/Violet legend is a dense paragraph, not a scannable rule; I had to read 'Promised $140.00' before trusting my balance
Home: 'send up to 200.00 / receive up to 3.00' reads like jargon to a first-timer
Receive: my entity id is a 64-char hex wall with no copy or short-id
No fiat/bank on-ramp screen is in this set — 'get money in' is only covered by Move/Reserve, not a first-timer funding flow

personas.name: Tomasz
personas.verdict: Thirty seconds is enough — credit is a cap, collateral is what's enforceable, and my risk is the violet part.
blockers: Account: 'your credit line to them 143.00' vs 'send up to 200.00' are two caps next to each other and I can't tell which is real
Account: 'in flight' appears only in the legend and is never shown as a live bar here
Home: I'd like at-a-glance inbound/outbound capacity per lane without opening each account

personas.name: Anya
personas.verdict: The book and the 1bp fee are real, but I can't see my own fills or resting orders in-line and the collateral slider is a wall I have to guess at.
blockers: Swap: the book is live·relay but 'Swap filled' in Activity isn't tappable back to the book; no resting-order/partial-fill view
Swap: no explicit price-impact/slippage warning for a 100 USDC ticket
Swap: the '100% collateral → 0% collateral' slider has no caption explaining the WETH trade-off

personas.name: Ravi
personas.verdict: 'Enforceable right now $40.00' plus Export CSV and proof hashes is exactly what my board asks for; I just need multi-sig and a consolidated settlement export.
blockers: Activity/Sovereignty: 'Export CSV' is a single text link with no board-level or settlement-summary export
Ownership: only '1 of 1 self-issued' — no way to add a quorum or rotate signers from this screen
Receipt: the proof hash is truncated with no copy/expand for an external verifier

personas.name: Sofia
personas.verdict: I can make a link and get a receipt, but this is a payment receipt, not an invoice my client can file.
blockers: Receive: no invoice fields (client, invoice number, due date, tax line) and the 'payment link' is generic
Receipt: it's a payment receipt with no client-facing header or line items
No invoice/create screen is in this set — only a receive/payment link

personas.name: Kenji
personas.verdict: Sovereignty is the most honest wallet screen I've seen — enforceability, evidence bundle, co-signed accounts, and 'can dispute without asking' — but I want the challenge window and per-hub evidence on the same surface.
blockers: Sovereignty: 'Save evidence bundle' exists but there's no explicit challenge-window countdown or which hub is disputable right now
Account: a Dispute button is present but no in-screen evidence digest for that specific counterparty
Sovereignty: no way to open frame #44 from the screen to verify it

personas.name: Lena
personas.verdict: Paying took three taps from the bottom nav — but I had to scroll the home and the receipt isn't one-hand friendly.
blockers: Home: the balance + legend sit above the fold so the top is cut; one-handed thumb can't reach everything without scrolling
Pay: the address and route chips are small targets for a moving thumb
Receive: the QR and copy-link are split across two screens

personas.name: Marcus
personas.verdict: I can size one counterparty, but I can't see my exposure across lanes at a glance and the Desk layout is just a Settings toggle, not a real desk.
blockers: Account: exposure is one lane at a time; 'Show 2 empty lanes - WETH, USDT' is plain text, not a tappable lane desk
Settings: the 'Desk' layout is described but not demonstrated on any screen here
Account: no aggregate across all counterparties (total credit extended, total collateral) on one screen

personas.name: Fatima
personas.verdict: I can see a route and a fee, but the cross-network hop I actually need isn't on these screens.
blockers: Swap: the 'Across networks' tab exists but no cross-network route or two-hop fee breakdown is shown
Pay: the route only shows H1→H2 (same network); no USDT across-chains example or explicit bridge fee
No screen in the set shows a cross-chain transfer with the total fee called out

personas.name: Dmitri
personas.verdict: In three minutes I understood the green/violet model and why it's safer than an exchange; the only thing that made me pause was the action button being the same color as the risk.
blockers: Home/Account: the Pay/Swap indigo is close to the 'promised' violet, so I briefly read the action as risky
Home: the legend is a paragraph I had to read rather than a rule I could scan
Swap: the collateral slider needs a one-line safety note (more collateral = less counterparty risk)
